title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Software Developer – Penendi At Penendi, we build mobile applications, SaaS products, and next-generation digital solutions powered by artificial intelligence. As our products continue to grow, we are expanding our team and looking for a Software Developer who will take an active role in building and improving our products. What you’ll do • Contribute to the development of new products and features • Improve the performance, scalability, and reliability of existing applications and services • Work on backend systems, APIs, and third-party integrations • Collaborate closely with product, design, and mobile development teams • Build scalable and maintainable software architectures • Research and adopt new technologies where they can create real product value What we’re looking for • Experience with modern software development practices • Knowledge of REST APIs, databases, and backend technologies • Familiarity with Git-based development workflows • Strong problem-solving skills and a product-oriented mindset • Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies • Ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment What we offer • The opportunity to work on products built for global markets • Projects focused on AI, mobile technologies, and SaaS • A fast-moving environment with minimal bureaucracy • A culture where ideas can quickly turn into real product features • The opportunity to contribute throughout the entire product lifecycle, from idea to launch and scale 📍 Istanbul / Hybrid 💼 Full-time At Penendi, we are looking for people who want to do more than simply complete tasks — we want teammates who take ownership and contribute to the future of the products they build.
